audit.summary: Two peripheral false scope statements, two invalid core derivations, and a printed covariance certificate defect with exact verified repair. Bilocal bound independently confirmed.
limitations: Almost-everywhere positivity does not imply independent-point positivity — Counterevidence: No full support assumption; pure-moment f would not exhibit this failure. Pointwise main theorem and pure-moment Bell applications are not refuted.

Boundedness does not imply archimedeanness for the stated arbitrary constraint set — Counterevidence: Finite-S1 interpretation excludes example but is not stated. Test pair need only satisfy used generators of a finite identity.

Empty-set construction does not yield the required nonnegative polynomial — Counterevidence: Original theorem conclusion actually true in this test case since -1 is an original cone generator. Switching to RV interpretation does not rescue the failed step.

Zero-moment homomorphism does not map the moment cone to the ordinary cone — Counterevidence: Correcting theorem-number citation alone cannot fix the generator failure; statement of corollary not disproved.

Printed covariance vector fails its exact certificate identity — Counterevidence: Inequality itself not refuted. Archived certificate notebook uses first-moment sum in the three entries and exact independent expansion confirms repaired identity.

repair.content:
Replace independent X in K by X in supp(mu). Continuity gives a.e. iff support-wise positivity; pushforward gives RV equivalence.

Adjoin a valid ball constraint; Theorem 4.2 then applies to enlarged cone, not original cone.

For nonempty K, moment evaluation at feasible delta_a preserves the cone.

Replace m110000 in entries 1,7,8 by m100000+m010000; unchanged G has all eight leading principal minors positive and residual identically zero.
